verdict.rationale: There is no documented way to export account data (request history, playground work, usage records) in any format. The only on-topic evidence concerns the 'leave' half of the story: TypeSafe publishes a drop-in replacement for the SDK's system_one API that runs on other LLM APIs, so code written against Jev can move off the platform. That adapter is framed mainly as a comparison tool, and third-party open-weight replicas exist, but neither is a data export feature. Missing for 10: a documented data export capability, open-format export of stored data such as history, playground state and usage logs, an account-deletion or offboarding process, and independent confirmation that migrating away works.
